name: council
description: 여러 AI 코딩 에이전트(Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, OpenRouter가 라우팅하는 모든 모델, 설치된 경우 codex·antigravity·grok·kimi·cursor CLI, 로컬 ollama 모델)에 동시에 물어 코딩 문제에 대한 다양한 관점을 모읍니다. tmux나 Claude Code 안의 스트리밍 패널을 제공하며, 켜면 코드 기본값인 codex가 긴 턴을 다시 읽고 입력창 위에 한 줄로 알려 주는 실시간 점검 기능도 있습니다.

pane_host.title: Pane opens in
pane_host.description: Where the council pane opens. claude-code draws it inside Claude Code; tmux leaves it to a tmux pane; ask asks once, the first time a run starts inside tmux, and remembers the answer (/council-pane ask forgets it). Outside tmux the pane opens here either way.

collapse_when_done.title: Collapse status when done
collapse_when_done.description: Open a finished run on its summary and the synthesis, with the seats folded below. Off keeps the live order: the seats, then the synthesis.

wake_on_async_done.title: Wake on async finish
wake_on_async_done.description: When a background council run (--async) finishes, submit a prompt so Claude fetches the result by itself. That starts a model turn and costs tokens; a failed run wakes nobody.

council_tool.title: Council as a tool
council_tool.description: Let Claude call the council as a tool, not only through /claude-council:ask. Every call shows you the question and the providers and asks before anything is sent.

heads_up.title: Heads-up side-check
heads_up.description: Turn the heads-up side-check on in every project: while Claude works a long turn, one council seat, codex by default, rereads the last five turns, the last eight tool results and the text Claude wrote with Write or Edit, and may show one line above the prompt. Nothing asks before a send; that material leaves the machine on every check. A project's .claude/council-heads-up.json overrides this for that project and picks the seat and cadence.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: The key the gemini seat uses, kept in Claude Code's secure storage. The council's mod sets GEMINI_API_KEY from it for every command in the session, over a shell export.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: The key the openai seat uses, kept in Claude Code's secure storage. The council's mod sets OPENAI_API_KEY from it for every command in the session, over a shell export.

xai_api_key.title: xAI API key (Grok)
xai_api_key.description: The key the grok seat uses, kept in Claude Code's secure storage. The council's mod sets XAI_API_KEY from it for every command in the session, over a shell export.

openrouter_models.title: OpenRouter models
openrouter_models.description: Model ids from openrouter.ai/models, separated by commas or spaces, such as deepseek/deepseek-v3.2,z-ai/glm-5.3. Each id becomes its own seat, openrouter-1, openrouter-2 and so on, all on the one OpenRouter key. The council's mod sets OPENROUTER_MODELS from it for every command in the session, over a shell export. Left empty, a shell export still applies; with neither, one openrouter seat runs the default model.
